# Dieter's Motors

> Family-owned auto, truck, diesel and RV repair shop in Oxnard, California, since 1972. All makes and models, with European specialists for Mercedes-Benz, BMW and Porsche. Smog check station ($59) and official CARB Clean Truck Check (HD I/M) test station ($99). Used car sales at the same address (usedcarsoxnard.com).

- Address: 2681 Ventura Blvd, Oxnard, CA 93036
- Phone: (805) 485-1575 (service) · (805) 321-0665 (used car sales, calls only)
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm, Sat 9am–1pm, Sun closed
- Serving: Oxnard, Camarillo, Ventura, Port Hueneme, El Rio, Saticoy, Santa Paula, Moorpark and Ventura County
- ASE-certified technicians, factory-level diagnostics, free estimates on most cars, loaner vehicles and local shuttle, 5.0 Google rating
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Book online: https://www.dietersmotors.com/schedule-service.html
